notes.title: Server Maintenance
notes.content:
General updates, New content, Balancing, Bug fixes and Kubberz implementations. General skill stability changes and more. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uzckhcv.png[/img]

[b]Summary[/b]
[list][*]Projectiles rework
[*]Dash adjustments
[*]Capre changes
[*]Gargarena changes
[*]Chipan changes
[*]Kururu changes
[*]Sharcry changes
[*]Moonflora changes
[*]Spintata changes
[*]Gurox changes
[*]Miniti changes
[*]Griffin changes
[*]New Map: Island
[*]Known Issues
[*]Received Feedback

[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mWK2sAI.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Projectiles Adjustments
Projectiles were previously having some inconsistencies. For this reason, we changed the way projectiles are launched to improve accuracy in relation to the center of the crosshairs as well as its responsiveness with higher pings. In this way, combat should feel more responsive to the player.

[*]Dash Adjustments
Changed the way dashes work. The player should notice an improvement in kubberz control while using dashes on some of them. The player should also notice less flickering when using dashes during gameplay. Now, the Dashes will also proportionally suffer the effects that the Kubber is suffering. That means, if a kubber is slow, for example, the dash will also be slower. The opposite is also valid.[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QpmbMAb.png[/img]

After the projectile changes, we noticed a high pace of ultimate generation and a high Kubber performance in combat. For this reason, we have made balance changes.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiles
[*]General improvements to Dashes
[*]Electric Advance
[*]Now can be used while in the air
[*]Magnetic Field now reflects Flashes of the Storm projectiles
[*]Basic Attack Ultimate Generation reduced from 25 to 4
[*]Lightning Ball Ultimate spawn reduced from 10 to 2[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AxzkaXX.png[/img]

Gargarena was having problems with her basic attack. After tweaking its attack along with its blinding effects, the kubber seems like a more viable option in combat.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiles
[*]General improvements to Dashes
[*]Black Hole agora now drags the enemy in a more effective and immersive way
[*]Mockery now hides information from other Kubberz while blindness is applied
[*]Adjustments to Basic Attack so the combo works properly[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/946yy9p.png[/img]

Chipan was performing below expectations due to implementation issues. After some changes, Chipan appears to be viable in combat.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiles
[*]General improvements to Dashes
[*]Ki Blow now Takes down flying Kubberz
[*]Bola now Takes down flying Kubberz
[*]Loaded Punch 
- Gameplay improvements
- Now can be used in the air
[*]Multiple Kicks
- Received improvements to its Hit Detection.
- Ultimate generation reduced from 10 to 2
- Reduced  overall damage
- Cooldown Increased
[*]Adjustments to Basic Attack to improve gameplay
[*]Fixed a bug that caused chipan to receive damage from his own basic attack
[*]Fixed a bug that caused chipan to not be able to hit Loaded punch after using basic attack[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e0vEc55.png[/img]

After internal testing, the gameplay improvements affected Kururu positively. However, we would like him to be a more viable alternative to fighting Griffin and other Kubberz.
[list][*]Oppressive Vortex agora now drags the enemy in a more effective and immersive way.
[*]Twist Attack received control and gameplay improvements. The player should notice greater responsiveness when using the attack
[*]Feather Dance
- Changed stamina cost from 55 to 65
- Changed critical chance from 0% to 5%
- General damage increased from 55 to 65[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lytrGIO.png[/img]

Sharcry now gains defense when using Salt Blades. This change was previously anticipated for overall Kubber balance.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiles
[*]General improvements to Dashes
[*]Salt Blades now increase all Sharcry’s defenses by 30%[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zIfV6In.png[/img]

After some feedback, we noticed that Moonflora’s stamina consumption was too high. For this reason, some changes were necessary to make it more viable while in combat.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiles
[*]General improvements to Dashes
[*]Floral Charge now can be used while in movement and keeping momentum in both stages of the combo
[*]Restoration Garden 
- Now can used while in movement and keeping momentum
- Cooldown changed to 12 seconds
- Stamina cost reduce from 450 to 400
[*]Seed Dam 
- Cooldown changed to 11 segundos
- Stamina cost reduced from 450 to 400
[*]VFX improvements on every Moonflora grass to have better contrast during gameplay[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KTVDdIy.png[/img]

Spintata was performing well before and after further testing. However, his ultimate was making him very vulnerable. For that reason, in addition to fixes, we’ve improved it’s ultimate.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiles
[*]General improvements to Dashes
[*]Dig and Cannonball now apply proper impulse during ending animation. 
[*]Quick Roll now can be used while in the air
[*]Improvements on Basic Attack
[*]Fury of the Sands 
- Now hides information from other Kubberz while blindness is applied
- Now increases all defenses by 50%[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NmKouI6.png[/img]

Gurox is a Kubber that the team is happy for its performance. For this reason, we only added quality of life changes.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiles
[*]General improvements to Dashes
[*]Crushin Leap now will apply accordingly to the ground, allowing new combat strategies
[*]Improvements on Basic Attack
[*]Nutcracker now Takes down flying Kubberz[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uz4dMX6.png[/img]

We noticed that the Miniti was performing below expectations. However, with the projectile improvements the Kubber has improved its overall performance. To make Miniti more competitive, we still increased some skill attributes.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiless.
[*]Adjustments to Basic Attack so the combo works properly
[*]Adjustments to Scratch so the combo works properly
[*]Fireball 
- Reduced cooldown from 2.5 seconds to 2 seconds
- General damage increased[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dJuwaOe.png[/img]

Griffin was performing above expectations, generating ultimate much faster than other Kubberz. For this reason, we have reduced his ultimate generation.
[list][*]General improvements to Projectiles
[*]General improvements to Dashes
[*]Reduced Life Regeneration when using Restoration
[*]Furry of Feathers reduced ultimate increment from 4 to 2.5[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HFsmZKV.png[/img]


[b]New Map[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vqQFQyD.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BUCnkvN.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zcqrPnh.png[/img]

Better for a more direct approach and bringing a better gameplay variety, we introduce you to a new map: The Island. On the Island, you’ll see combats that are less spaced and at the same time more open. Enemies will be easier to find and given the small nature of the map, fights will be more chaotic than ever. We are also introducing a new feature on the map: Slow Puddles
[hr][/hr]

[b]Slow Puddles[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gXbueQS.png[/img]

A new mechanic that will be further explored, the slow puddles will make every character that stays in that area have reduced speed. You can use that as an advantage in combat. For now, every Kubber suffers the same effects while on the puddles but we intend to add more variety of reactions to this mechanic in the future.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Scoreboard at the end of the match[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rIEnIJX.png[/img]

We noticed that our players were not happy that they could not see how well they did during a match. For this reason, we are adding a scoreboard at the end of the match.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Known issues[/b]
[list][*]The damage calculation is causing inconsistencies in its results, bringing unwanted values. The calculation must be revised later. For this reason, there haven’t been any more significant balance updates
[*]There is a chance for the player to crash through map collisions, spoiling the player’s experience.
[*]The player may experience issues with skill selection input, causing delays and inconsistencies in selection. There are plans to solve this problem, but some design and programming system reformulations are needed
[*]There is a bug that does not return the player’s default speed after a slowed Kubber is defeated.[/list]

[b]Received Feedbacks[/b]
[list][*]There is little or no feedback when an enemy is defeated
[*]Hit Feedback is less prominent
[*]The way skills are launched (Selecting it and then clicking with the right button) is not intuitive.[/list]
